beats.summary: Angela and a man share a bale of hay and joke about the holiday being about money.

evidence.snippet: Angela: Yeah, instead of Hay Place, it should be pay place.
Angela: Mm. Yeah, so we can celebrate Thanksgiving-Me-Your-Money Day.

beats.summary: Pam confronts Michael about his one-sided friendship with Ryan and warns him about others' investments.

evidence.snippet: Pam: And there are a lot of other people in this office who have money at stake.

beats.summary: Michael and Ryan discuss financial struggles and Ryan's ideas requiring money.

evidence.snippet: Michael: Maybe I could take a second mortgage on my condo.

beats.summary: Dwight crowns himself Hay King after a three-way tie and admits he did it to rectify a childhood disappointment.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: Did I truck 300 bales of hay to a parking lot to rectify some childhood disappointment? Yes.

beats.summary: Darryl, Andy, Stanley confront Ryan and Michael about selling their investment in WUPHF, but Michael refuses to sell.

evidence.snippet: Darryl: You got this crazy opportunity to get our money back. Tell Mike To Sell.
Michael: I. Do not agree to sell, which is to say nay.

beats.summary: Michael expresses belief in Ryan despite others' doubts and gives Ryan nine days to save everyone's money.
